name: GST3D (GST3D S.L.)
summary: Ultra-budget Barcelona-based filament brand serving the EU and Latin America, best known for very cheap PLA+ in a wide colour range. The company claims European manufacture but names no facility, and community reviews repeatedly flag batch-to-batch quality variability.

product_lines.name: PLA+ (Solid / Space / Silk / Fluor / Bright / Marble)
product_lines.notes: The volume line: a toughened PLA+ base across many finishes, including a silk variant. Marble and Space are pigment effects on the same base.

product_lines.name: GST3D TPU
product_lines.notes: Flexible TPU; no shore hardness published.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 8-15/kg, among the cheapest filament sold in Europe. manufacturing_countries is empty because 'manufactured in Europe' is an unsupported marketing claim: no plant, address or contract extruder is disclosed, and Spain is confirmed only as the commercial base.

provenance.conflicts: Two unresolved points: the 'manufactured in Europe' claim has no supporting facility information, and independent reviews report noticeable batch-to-batch quality variability (diameter and colour consistency) that the brand does not address.
